PlayerService

class PlayerService(*args, **kwargs)[source]

Bases: QObject

Business rules (service layer) of players.

A single instance is shared by the whole application.

Parameters:
daoPlayerCsvDAO | None, optional

DAO used for persistence. Default is None, which creates a new PlayerCsvDAO.

Attributes:
player_changeSignal(int)

Emitted after a change: with the ID of the created or updated player, or with 0 after a deletion.

daoPlayerCsvDAO

DAO used for persistence.

Methods

get_all_players()

Return all registered players.

Return the validation errors of the form data.

Create a player from a data dictionary.

Update an existing player.

Delete a player by its ID.

find_by_id(player_id)

Return a player by its ID.

search_players(query=””)

Search players by name or ID (case-insensitive).

Notes

__new__ always returns the same instance, and __init__ sets it up only once: a dao passed in later calls is ignored.

Return all registered players.

list[Player]

The players cached by the DAO.

validate_data(data)[source]

Validate the form data of a player.

Parameters:
datadict[str, Any]

Form data.

Returns:
list[str]

Translated error messages, each ending with a newline; empty when the data is valid.

Notes

The id is required and must be an int; name must not be blank; birth_date is required.

The messages (pt_BR source texts) are translated at runtime with self.tr().

create_player(data)[source]

Create a player from a dictionary.

Parameters:
datadict[str, Any]

Values for every Player field. An id of 0 or less gets the next free ID.

Returns:
Player | None

The created player, or None if it is not valid or its ID already exists.

Raises:
TypeError

If data misses a field or has an unknown key.

Notes

player_change is emitted with the new ID on success.

update_player(player_id, data)[source]

Update an existing player with new values.

Parameters:
player_idint

ID of the player to update.

datadict[str, Any]

Updated fields; missing keys keep the current value.

Returns:
bool

True if the player was found, is valid and was saved; False otherwise.

Notes

The cached object is changed in place before validation, so an invalid update still changes it in memory. player_change is emitted with the ID on success.

delete_player(player_id)[source]

Delete a player by its ID.

Parameters:
player_idint

ID of the player to delete.

Returns:
bool

True if deleted, False if the player was not found.

Raises:
BusinessRuleException

If the player has a KarTEA configuration (PlayerKarteaConfigService); the message is translated with self.tr().

Notes

player_change is emitted with 0 on success.
